# Set up environment
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# Load necessary
library(qqman)
library(circlize)
```

# SNP-GWAS
```{r}
SNPGWAS_data <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/SNPGWAS_Fasttree_LMM_max5missing.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)|> 
  mutate(POS=as.integer(str_split(as.character(variant), "_", simplify = T)[,2]), 
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1"))

# Extract "BP" from the first column by splitting at "_"
positions <- sapply(strsplit(as.character(SNPGWAS_data[[1]]), "_"), function(x) x[2])

# Get significance threshold
p_threshold_SNPGWAS <- 0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_data)

# Construct final data frame
out_df <- data.frame(
  CHR = 1,
  SNP = ".",
  BP = as.numeric(positions),
  P = as.numeric(SNPGWAS_data$lrt.pvalue),
  r2 = 0
)

# Prepare annotations
SNPGWAS_ann_sub <- SNPGWAS_data %>%
  filter(lrt.pvalue < p_threshold_SNPGWAS) %>%
  separate(
    notes, 
    into = c("contig_position", "upstream", "gene_in", "downstream"), 
    sep = ";", 
    remove = FALSE, 
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_in) %>%
  slice_min(lrt.pvalue, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%  
  ungroup()

# Manhattan Plot
# SNPGWAS_manplot <- manhattan(
#   out_df,
#   ylim = c(0, 4) ,
#   chr = "CHR",
#   bp = "BP",
#   pval = "P", 
#   snp = "SNP",
#   main = "Manhattan Plot of SNP-GWAS\n Population Structure Controlled w/: FastTree (LMM)",
#   col = "skyblue",
#   genomewideline = -log10(p_threshold_SNPGWAS), 
#   suggestiveline = F, 
#   annotatePval = 0.01)

SNPGWAS_manplot <- ggplot(SNPGWAS_data, aes(x=POS, y=-log10(lrt.pvalue))) +
  geom_point(aes(color=OR_pos), alpha=0.8, size=1.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values= c("skyblue", "orange"))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0) ) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(), 
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic Position (Start)",
    y = expression(-log[10](italic(p))),
    title = "SNPGWAS Manhattan Plot with Significant Hits Annotated"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_threshold_SNPGWAS), color="red", lty="dashed") 


SNPGWAS_manplot_5_95 <- ggplot(SNPGWAS_data |> filter(af>=0.05, af <0.95), 
                               aes(x=POS, y=-log10(lrt.pvalue))) +
  geom_point(aes(color=OR_pos), alpha=0.8, size=1.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values= c("skyblue", "orange"))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0) ) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(), 
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic Position (Start)",
    y = expression(-log[10](italic(p))),
    title = "SNPGWAS Manhattan Plot with Significant Hits Annotated"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05/nrow(SNPGWAS_data|> filter(af>=0.05, af <0.95))), color="red", lty="dashed") 


# QQ plot 
# SNPGWAS_qqplot <- qq(out_df$P)
# Construct final data frame

SNPGWAS_qqplot <- data.frame(expected= (-log10(ppoints(length(SNPGWAS_data |> pull(lrt.pvalue))))), 
                             observed=(-log10(sort(SNPGWAS_data |> pull(lrt.pvalue))))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color="red", lty="dashed") +
  xlim(0, 8) +          # change x axis limits here
  ylim(0, 8) +          # and y axis limits if desired
  labs(
    x = "-log10(Expected P)",
    y = "-log10(Observed P)",
    title = "SNPGWAS QQ plot"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

SNPGWAS_qqplot_5_95 <- data.frame(expected= (-log10(ppoints(length(SNPGWAS_data|> filter(af>=0.05, af <0.95) |> pull(lrt.pvalue))))), 
                             observed=(-log10(sort(SNPGWAS_data |> filter(af>=0.05, af <0.95)|> pull(lrt.pvalue))))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color="red", lty="dashed") +
  xlim(0, 8) +          # change x axis limits here
  ylim(0, 8) +          # and y axis limits if desired
  labs(
    x = "-log10(Expected P)",
    y = "-log10(Observed P)",
    title = "SNPGWAS QQ plot"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


# DB-GWAS
```{r}
data_DBGWAS <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/DBGWAS_Fasttree_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T) |> filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)

data_DBGWAS_annotations <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/DBGWAS_Fasttree_LMM_annotation.txt", sep = "\t", header=F)
colnames(data_DBGWAS_annotations) <- colnames(data_DBGWAS)
data_DBGWAS_annotations <- data_DBGWAS_annotations |> filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)

# Split the annotation column

# Extract contig/chromosome
data_DBGWAS_annotations <- data_DBGWAS_annotations |>
  mutate(coord_range = str_extract(notes, "(?<=:)[0-9]+-[0-9]+"),
         start = as.integer(str_extract(coord_range, "^[0-9]+")),
         end = as.integer(str_extract(coord_range, "(?<=-)[0-9]+")), 
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1")) 



# Extract "BP" from the first column by splitting at "_"
positions_DBGWAS_start <- data_DBGWAS_annotations$start

# Get significance threshold
p_threshold_DBGWAS <- 0.05/nrow(data_DBGWAS_annotations)

# Construct final data frame
out_df_DBGWAS <- data.frame(
  CHR = 1,
  SNP = ".",
  BP = as.numeric(positions_DBGWAS_start),
  P= data_DBGWAS_annotations$lrt.pvalue,
  r2 = 0
)

ann_sub <- data_DBGWAS_annotations %>%
  filter(lrt.pvalue < p_threshold_DBGWAS) %>%
  separate(
    notes, 
    into = c("contig_position", "upstream", "gene_in", "downstream"), 
    sep = ";", 
    remove = FALSE, 
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_in) %>%
  slice_min(lrt.pvalue, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%  
  ungroup()

# Manhattan Plot
# manhattan(
#   out_df_DBGWAS,
#   ylim = c(0, 12) ,
#   chr = "CHR",
#   bp = "BP",
#   p = "P",  # Use the column with -log10(p-values)
#   snp = "SNP",
#   main = "Manhattan Plot of DBGWAS\n Population Structure Controlled w/: FastTree (LMM)",
#   col = "skyblue", 
#   genomewideline = -log10(p_threshold_DBGWAS),  
#   suggestiveline =F, 
#   annotatePval =  -log10(p_threshold_DBGWAS)
# )
DBGWAS_manplot <- ggplot(data_DBGWAS_annotations, aes(x=start, y=-log10(lrt.pvalue))) +
    # Show all points
  geom_point(aes(color=OR_pos), alpha=0.8, size=1.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values= c("skyblue", "orange"))+
    # custom X axis:
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0) ) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(), 
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic Position (Start)",
    y = expression(-log[10](italic(p))),
    title = "DBGWAS Manhattan Plot with Significant Hits Annotated"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_threshold_DBGWAS), color="red", lty="dashed") +
    geom_label_repel(data=ann_sub, aes(label=gene_in), size=2,min.segment.length = 0.5) 

# QQ plot 
# qq(out_df_DBGWAS$P)

n <- length(out_df_DBGWAS$P)
expected <- -log10(ppoints(n))
observed <- -log10(sort(out_df_DBGWAS$P))
df <- data.frame(expected, observed)

ggplot(df, aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color="red", lty="dashed") +
  xlim(0, 12) +          # change x axis limits here
  ylim(0, 12) +          # and y axis limits if desired
  labs(
    x = "-log10(Expected P)",
    y = "-log10(Observed P)",
    title = "QQ plot"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Table of significant genes
gene_hits = read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/gene_hits.txt", stringsAsFactors=FALSE, header=TRUE)

# Plot of sig hits 

gene_hits|>
  filter(maxp> -log10(p_threshold_DBGWAS))|>
ggplot(aes(x=avg_beta, y=maxp, colour=avg_maf, size=hits, label=gene)) +
   geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
   geom_text_repel(aes(size=60), show.legend = FALSE, colour='black') +
   scale_size("Number of k-mers", range=c(1,10)) +
   scale_colour_gradient('Average MAF') +
   theme_bw(base_size=14) +
   ggtitle("EOD vs LOD") +
   xlab("Average effect size") +
   ylab("Maximum -log10(p-value)")

```

```{r}
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_CDC")
cl_eggnogg <- read.delim("panaroo_annotation.txt", sep = "\t", header=F, comment.char = "#")
web_eggnogg <- read.delim("web_panaroo_annotations.txt", sep = "\t", header=F, comment.char = "#")

cl_eggnogg |> filter(! V1 %in% web_eggnogg$V1)
web_eggnogg |> filter(! V1 %in% cl_eggnogg$V1)

web_eggnogg |> filter(V1  cl_eggnogg$V1)

test<- left_join(cl_eggnogg |> select(V1, V7, V8) |> rename("gene"="V1", "cl_COG"="V7", "cl_class"="V8"), 
          web_eggnogg |> select(V1, V7, V8) |> rename("gene"="V1", "web_COG"="V7", "web_class"="V8"))
test  |> 
  select(gene, cl_COG, web_COG)|> 
  filter(cl_COG != web_COG)

test  |> 
  mutate(cl_COG = ifelse(cl_COG =="-", "S", cl_COG))|> 
  mutate(web_COG = ifelse(web_COG =="-", "S", web_COG))|> 
  filter(cl_COG != web_COG)

web_eggnogg$V8 != cl_eggnogg$V8

nrow(cl_eggnogg)
nrow(web_eggnogg)+267
```
